summary: This PR is a type-only fix: it changes default generic parameters for `Factory`/`createFactory` from `any` to `Env`/`string`, and adds an explicit return type to `Factory.createMiddleware`. No runtime logic changed (same `middleware` value returned), and new type-level tests (`ExtractSchema` equality checks) were added to verify the fix for the linked issue. The main residual risk is that changing defaults from `any` to concrete types could tighten inference elsewhere in the codebase for callers that relied on the permissive `any` default, but this is exactly the intended behavior fix and is covered by the new test.
